en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5416 - Al-Abbas ibn Amir narrated from Aban from Abu Basir from Abu Abdullah Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as), who said:
"Whoever does not make a proper will at the time of death, it is a deficiency in his dignity and intellect."

Imam (as) also said: "Indeed, the Messenger of Allah (swt) (peace be upon him and his family) made a will to Ali (as), and Ali (as) made a will to Al-Hasan (as), and Al-Hasan (as) made a will to Al-Hussain (as), and Al-Hussain (as) made a will to Ali ibn Al-Hussain (as), and Ali ibn Al-Hussain (as) made a will to Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as)."
